## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run gates` passes locally (typecheck, lint, tests + coverage floor, content validation, build)
- [ ] `npm run validate:content` passes (if content changed)
- [ ] New behavior has tests; accepted review findings have regression tests
- [ ] No article content hardcoded in components; content lives in `content/articles/`
- [ ] No AI/semantic features introduced (text search only)
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant (README, SPEC, CHANGELOG)
